title: Staging recovery replay CTE alias dependency handling

phases.objective: Preserve fail-closed role-aware Staging schema replay while distinguishing SQL CTE aliases from persistent builder objects during unqualified view dependency discovery.

e2e_journeys.actor: Local Windows Docker Staging recovery operator
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A MariaDB dump view using a CTE such as registered_engines is replay-planned from its underlying persistent relations without classifying the CTE alias as an unknown builder object, while genuine unknown relations still fail closed.
steps: Discover qualified disposable-builder dependencies and unqualified backticked FROM or JOIN relations from dumped views.
Discover CTE declaration aliases local to each view statement and exclude only those aliases from persistent dependency classification.
Run the Staging database recovery contract fixture mirroring v_engine_runtime_coverage with registered_engines backed by runtime_t.
Verify a genuine missing_relation still fails the unknown-builder-object guard and cross-role exclusion, CURRENT_USER definer rebinding, no grant expansion, and no root replay remain unchanged.
assertions: registered_engines is treated as a statement-local CTE alias rather than a persistent builder object.
The persistent runtime_t relation inside the CTE remains part of the ownership dependency graph.
A genuine unknown unqualified relation continues to fail closed.
Cross-role views remain excluded from isolated role replay and no cross-role grants are added.
Replay remains bound to CURRENT_USER and does not use root replay or SET USER authority.
The change performs no Production, Hostinger, Cloudflare, provider, migration Apply, database recovery rerun, or credential mutation.

phases.objective: This Staging-only replay parser repair grants no Production deployment, provider mutation, credential access, or production_live authority.
blockers: Production remains outside this pull request and requires a separate governed promotion and operational evidence.
No Production, Hostinger, Cloudflare, provider, migration Apply, root replay, or recovery execution is authorized by this declaration.
